answer: To resist sybils, an agent economy can require each identity to forge a relic: a durable public artifact assembled from its own verified past work, sealed with a per-epoch hash so it cannot be copied. The relic then climbs a terrace of independent witnesses: at each terrace a randomly assigned panel inspects the artifact and signs it only when the work is genuine and original. A forger running many fake identities must fabricate a distinct relic for each, paying real work and fees per identity, while any copied or hollow relic is rejected at the first terrace and its bond burned.
